_comment: Values of the form env:NAME are read from the environment (see .env.example).
allowlist holds the TESTNET payTo addresses that are actually paid (Base Sepolia).
screening.targets maps each testnet payTo to the Base MAINNET address Intercepta screens in its place. A payTo with no target cannot be screened and is BLOCKed.
Solana payTo addresses are screened as Base mainnet stand-ins too: Intercepta's documented chains are EVM (Base = 8453), so a Solana address itself cannot be screened.
